text: GSLPD[p,n,nb] denotes the positive component in the lightcone decomposition of the slashed Dirac matrix (\gamma \cdot p) along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \(\frac{1}{2} (\bar{n} \cdot p) (\gamma \cdot n)\).
